rule_correction.publication_time_role: matching/discovery only; never event time and never sufficient to choose an approved event episode
rule_correction.strict: requires episode-specific temporal evidence with exactly one supported raw episode ID
rule_correction.generic_alert_relation: single-episode local date may be episode-specific; multi-episode local date remains needs_review
rule_correction.contemporaneous_live: trusted live wording is strict only when the live message timestamp lies inside exactly one active raw episode
rule_correction.explicit_event_time: resolved against all tracked episodes, independently of publication-time matching
rule_correction.near_boundary: sensitivity only with explicit event time and one supported raw episode
rule_correction.inferred_same_attack: multi-episode local dates require review; conservative inference retained only on a single-episode local date with publication-window consistency
rule_correction.controlled_blast: planned/quarry/blasting event segment is deterministic non-military reject unless that same segment contains military-strike evidence
